verdict.rationale: Epic's license page lists "Access to the source code" and "All platforms & features". A community user independently notes Unreal "has source code included". The probe confirms the EpicGames/UnrealEngine repository exists but is EULA/account-gated, which is a caveat on access rather than a contradiction. The evidence establishes read access only: no evidence shows modifying and rebuilding the full engine source, and the plugin docs on modifying built-in engine features describe an adjacent extension mechanism. missing for 10: explicit documentation that licensees may modify and rebuild the full engine source, documented steps for obtaining and building engine source, hands-on corroboration of custom engine modifications.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can read and modify the full engine source when I hit a wall

citations.quote: Unreal Engine looks amazing, is cheap or free for indie studios, and has source code included.
